text: Adversarial round-2 repairs implemented: t-test direction is explicitly BminusA to match meta-analysis; discovery output reports uncorrected TP/FP against truth; Stouffer weighting text is accurate; spatial-FDR hero map compares estimates and decisions to the known active cube; deprecated CSV constructors removed; public groupB contrast examples repaired.
